en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Zurara, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>:

‘Regarding the one leg is half the wergild; and regarding the ear is half the wergild when it is cut off from its roots, and when it is cut from its surroundings, so regarding it is a just value; and regarding the nose when it is cut, is the complete wergild; and regarding the back when it is broken to the extents that its owner cannot bring down the semen, is the complete wergild; and regarding the manhood when it is cut off, is the complete wergild; and regarding the tongue when it is cut off is the complete wergild’.
